Name: Trashbear Travel Obelisks as Furniture for 1.6
Author: LCKa
Description:
Small update to 1.1.0 to remove the obelisk furniture from random sales and also make its availability conditional on location-based restrictions for those who side with Morris and don't go the Community Center route. Trashbear is iffy about that decision.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Lavliette's Trashbear Travel Obelisks ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12490]found here[/url]) are a source of endless joy to me, yet there are so many mods out there with beautiful obelisks one wants to try. So what's a trashbear enthusiast to do? Well, convert them into furniture of course! You can now put them in all your favorite places, on the top of a mountain, deep inside the jungle, or inside buildings. Have that furry glutton smile at you while you're fishing by the lake, or keep bad dreams at bay from beside your bed if you want. You can even get as many as you want, and transform the valley into an altar to the lovable icon. Gone are the days when we could only have one of each, take your Trashbear Travel Obelisks with you on the fly and don't forget to tip your [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lavliette?gameId=1303]guide[/url]! (all credits go to Lavliette)

To keep it somewhat lore-friendly, the Trashbear Obelisks furniture is available at a certain forest friend's shop (who has their own reputation as a trash connoisseur), and some of them are only available after you've reached a certain location. Their size (3x5) is not as massive as the base obelisks (3x8), so they can be put inside, but place them well: keep in mind they are as big as the Winter Star Tree.

This mod takes advantage of SV 1.6 new features, so it won't work on earlier versions.
Again, the original mod is Lavliette´s, and all the assets are theirs. All kudos should be directed their way, but report any technical issues to me, please.
Thank you, Lavliette, for allowing me to use your art. It's lovely and has never failed to brighten my day.
